name: Black
source:
You awake somewhere dark, with seemingly no memories of your past or your whereabouts.

And it's black. So black.

Be careful.

[From [url=https://schivafrecce.itch.io/black]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在黑暗的地方醒来，似乎没有关于你的过去或你的行踪的记忆。

而且它是黑色的。这么黑。

当心。

[来自[url=https://schivafrecce.itch.io/black]itch.io[/url]]
